r.balance: Trial Balance: Templates → Balance. Verify Debit = Credit. If they don't match, there's an entry error.
r.banco: Bank Reconciliation: Templates → Reconciliation. Compare bank balance vs your books. Identify outstanding checks and uncleared deposits.
